reaction: Second visit tonight, big screen. This time the first picture has the title; last time it was an empty frame. New game.
Last time on desktop I chose the earlier time to be safe. I do it again.
Reread 1: You also stop at a place on the path when nobody behind can hear you. What place? Why can they not hear me? The first sentences about lead on and climb on are clear now. I go on.
Ask everyone to climb on, as I now know.
Gentle again. insist is greyed with after a refusal.
I want to see the Journal again; it was my favourite part.
The Journal is plain and readable. It tells the people as small stories: Tamar checked boots, Nell promised her mother a call. This is still the part I like. Back to the hill.

I know the loop from the phone: promise a turn-back time, ask gently, lead on, wait. One reread so far: the sentence about stopping where nobody behind can hear me. The Journal is warm and clear. The clock has not moved, so I am waiting for the climb.
The clock is stuck at 05:03 and says Time slows for reading. I close the note with the x to see if the climb moves.
Nothing moves. I am not sure my first lead on worked. I press it again.
The clock moves now, 05:05. Hint text changed to a new one about pack and food. I wait.
Clock 05:20 now. A line says Nell borrowed her crampons, spikes for walking on ice. I like that the game explains the word.
The picture is clear: the five are in a line, I am the red one at the front. The path runs off under the right panel, so I cannot see where it goes. I wait.
Twenty minutes of game time in thirty real seconds. I try Skip.
error: Skip is not on the page now, and it was not in the last reply either; copy one full name from clickable in this reply (not a driver failure)

reaction: Skip is not on the page, same as on the phone. It comes and goes and I do not know why. I wait.
Calm and readable. One reread only (nobody behind can hear you). The people are now below me and I mostly wait. The Journal and the small stories still hold me; the waiting does not.
I have seen the loop again. I open the menu to find Feedback.
Skip came back behind the menu, as the clock stopped. I open Feedback.
I press I am stopping by position. I type nothing and press no Submit.
Back. The note box filled itself with the verdict words; I typed nothing.

I stop the desktop here. Only one sentence needed a reread, so I did not hit my quit rule. But I have seen the same loop twice tonight: ask, lead on, wait for the clock, and Skip comes and goes. I would close it, not leave it running. In Feedback I pressed I am stopping, typed nothing, no Submit.
